title: CD Laser Wavelength Mystery

scenes.text: CD players emit a 780 nm infrared beam to read data.
Many think CDs use a visible red laser like DVD players.
scenes.label: Visible red laser myth
scenes.query2: CD vs DVD laser color myth

scenes.text: The standard for CD‑ROMs is an infrared laser around 780 nm, while DVDs use a shorter 640 nm red laser for higher density.
scenes.label: Infrared CD laser reality

scenes.text: That’s why a DVD laser can’t read a CD accurately.
scenes.label: Laser mismatch
scenes.query: why DVD laser can't read CD

description: A popular myth says CDs read with the same red laser as DVDs. The real science involves an invisible infrared beam. Discover the details in a flash.
